subject: Difficulty connecting to AWS redshift database using shinyapps

messages.author: 556c9814a6b7a62c
messages.subject: Difficulty connecting to AWS redshift database using shinyapps
parts:
Hello.  I have data saved on a AWS redshift server that would like to load from my deployed shinyapps.io app.  On my local machine I have used RODBC library to establish a ODBC connection sing driver DSN setup using the redshift driver (see link http://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/install-odbc-driver-windows.html).  Then I just used "odbcConnect" RODBC function to establish the connection in my R session.  Does anyone know I can do this with Shiny and Shinyapps, or have any other suggestions on how to establish a connection to the database?  

I also found some other discussions on how I might do this, but I could not understand Tareef Kawaf response.  He also mentioned that they are writing an article about this, and was wondering if anyone knew whether they had yet?  
https://support.rstudio.com/hc/communities/public/questions/203051837-How-to-Connect-to-External-Database-AWS-?locale=en-us  


Thanks in advance for any comments/suggestions!

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Difficulty connecting to AWS redshift database using shinyapps
parts:
Kevin,

I think the problem here is that shinyapps.io doesn't have the AWS Redshift ODBC drivers installed. I took a quick look and it doesn't seem like the Redshift drivers are supported on Ubuntu linux (which is what the shinyapps.io servers use). There might be some way around this, but I will have to do some investigation. In the meantime, however, i wanted to mention that its possible to use the the RPostgresql package to connect to redshift (since redshift is based on PostgreSQL). Do you think this is something you could look into as an alternative?

-Andy
